description: The only way to give this round's answer on a blocked command's rerun request. Fill the fields and call it; the platform adds the request, its revision and the Goal digest and stores the answer. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.choice: One of allow_rerun (this form may run once), deny (not in this Run), escalate (the person decides).
parameters.escalationKind: Only when choice is escalate: requirement, product_tradeoff or architecture.
parameters.rationale: The basis of the judgement, 1-2000 characters.
parameters.plain: One plain sentence for the person, one line, 1-200 characters.
